coverage: The angle named kinds of source rather than URLs, so the roster was built by kind: close-reading blogs FETCHED (Looping Wor(l)d, The Wertzone, Fantasy-Faction, HearWriteNow, Fantasy-Hive, The Quaint Book Nook, Omnilegent, Once Upon a Bookcase, Grimdark); novelists' line-level essays FETCHED (Natasha Pulley and Steven Erikson at Tor.com/Reactor, M Harold Page at Black Gate); a peer-reviewed close reading FETCHED (Matthew Oliver, Mythlore 41.1, via a Wayback PDF capture after the live PDF returned a 151,139-byte HTML interstitial); a 500-plus-entry chapter-by-chapter reread FETCHED (Geoffrey B. Elliott, five entries); Substack close readings FETCHED (The Huntress And The Wolf; Jeffrey O on the epigraphs); Hobb's own words FETCHED (robinhobb.com blog; the Writing Excuses 11.Bonus-01 transcript; The Arched Doorway SFContario transcript and the New Statesman interview, both via Wayback; Dragonsteel Nexus); and a reading group FETCHED but thin (Goodreads Fantasy Buddy Reads). BLOCKED: reddit.com r/Fantasy (403 on JSON and HTML with a browser user agent, 302 loop on old.reddit, and the one reachable redlib mirror serves an Anubis proof-of-work challenge, which I did not attempt); YouTube video-essay transcripts (no extractor available, transcript proxies return empty) — this is the one limb of the angle left unfilled; the wetranscripts LiveJournal copy of the Writing Excuses episode (shell only, read at writingexcuses.com instead); the tapatalk Robin Hobb forum reread threads (784 bytes of shell). NOT FOUND: Ekman and Taylor 2021, "Between World and Narrative: Fictional Epigraphs and Critical World-Building", chased from Oliver's footnote 1 (CONTENTdm is JavaScript-driven and Academia.edu needs a login) — recommend a library route next round. Substantive sources per route: 13 from the named kinds, 6 from bibliography chasing (Oliver plus five Elliott entries), 7 from lateral searches. 26 substantive sources, 109 single-limb claims; every quotation was re-checked verbatim against the fetched text by script, which caught and fixed one over-length quote and one line-wrap mismatch.
